growth.title: Growth
growth.desc: Every week, data from across the back office is rolled into one list: declining pages, pages close to page one, searches with no page, new competitor pages, AI recommending others, site issues, unhandled inquiries… Each item says why and what to do next; "Do it" takes you to the right page.
growth.hint: Sorted by impact; click "Done" when finished, and it comes back next week if the signal is still there
growth.empty: Nothing to do in this group right now. It is recalculated every week.
